summary: The Fund filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to 15,000,000 common shares. Distributed via ALPS Distributors, Inc., with UBS Securities LLC as sub-placement agent, sales are at market prices subject to a minimum price equal to NAV plus commission, per the 1940 Act. This is a routine registered offering, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are involved; the filing is standard capital raising.
